guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the 'no gold system' premise is FALSE -- the sim has RunState.gold, RunState.gain_gold and a rewards screen that banks gold through it (PROMPT.md bug class 12)
guards.issue: MECHANISM: DragonFruit.cs:22-29 grants MaxHpVar(1) on every gold gain by its owner. The port implements nothing. THE PREMISE IS FALSE, and this is the same false premise batch 1 already disproved for relic/amethyst_aubergine ('the sim has no gold'), which .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep C lists in the same family: the sim has RunState.gold (run.py:152), RunState.gain_gold (run.py:325-333) with a live Hook.ModifyGoldGained chain, twelve ported events that call it, and a reward screen that banks combat gold through it (rewards.py:464, :485). REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes_b04.py stubs): `run.gain_gold(25)` moves gold 99 -> 124 and leaves max_hp at 80 both with and without the relic, where C# gives 81. Both sides ported and no unported content needed: Dragon Fruit is Shop rarity in the transcribed grab bag (relic_pools.py:65 'RELIC.DRAGON_FRUIT'), and gold is gained after essentially every combat, so the relic would be paying out several times per act. IMPLEMENTATION NOTE: unlike relic/dollys_mirror's stub this needs a NEW base hook -- executed, `hasattr(Relic, 'after_gold_gained')` is False, and sweep C explicitly EXCLUDED AfterGoldGained from its 33 one-relic fixes for that reason. Two details of the C# dispatch that the hook must reproduce, both read off PlayerCmd.GainGold: AfterGoldGained fires AFTER `player.Gold += amount` (PlayerCmd.cs:168-169), so the relic sees the new balance; and it is behind the `if (!(amount > 0m)) return;` bail at PlayerCmd.cs:146-149, so a player who also holds relic/ectoplasm (which zeroes the gain) gets NO Max HP -- getting that wrong would turn the two relics from an anti-synergy into a combo. RULE 7: run.py, rewards.py, relic_pools.py, relics/base.py and PlayerCmd.cs are not hashed here.

Nothing unported is needed -- executed, RunState.total_floor already exists (`hasattr(run, 'total_floor')` is True), which is why sweep B calls this 'one base-class member plus one filter in the pull path' and the highest-leverage relic fix it found.
